explanation: IsSmoothVector G v is defined in this library as IsOpen of the stabilizer of v. I found no Mathlib declaration saying that the stabilizer of g • v is open when the stabilizer of v is open, in a topological group action with ContinuousMul. I grepped for `IsOpen` together with `stabilizer`. The hits were `stabilizer_isOpen` (discrete X), the `ContinuousSMul` iff lemma in Topology/Algebra/MulAction.lean, and one in KrullTopology; none of them is the stability statement. `MulAction.stabilizer_smul_eq_stabilizer_map_conj` is the algebraic ingredient. Deriving the result from it would still need the openness of a conjugated subgroup, a continuity argument that takes more than two short lines.
